ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, November 18, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Technical Systems Management, French Commercial, Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, General Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, November 25, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. No exceptions will be made. BADM 310 is offered online in the summer and winter terms as well as the spring semester with an enrollment limit. There are currently 20 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 24, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course. This is a core course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technical Systems Management or Food Science & Human Nutrition or Curric Unassigned or Accountancy or General Engineering or Industrial Engineering or French Commercial Studies or Supply Chain Management or Finance or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Business Process Management or Management or Systems Engineering and Design or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s) or minor(s).
